verdict.rationale: Supabase CLI supports fully headless, keyless project scaffolding (`supabase init`, `supabase start`) confirmed hands-on via probe, and RLS policies plus auth methods can be declared via SQL migrations applied through the CLI/MCP `apply_migration`/`execute_sql` tools, enabling an agent to script schema, auth, and policy setup end-to-end. missing for 10: no single end-to-end documented script/example showing an agent provisioning schema+auth+RLS together in one automated run, and no independent (non-vendor) verification of this exact workflow.
